acyclic_roles.payload_descriptors: Exactly five separately typed records: CPU, three ordered GGUF shards and frozen pack. They are outside static software; metadata preparation compares recorded strings/bytes/hashes only. No stat/lstat/resolve/safe/open/pin/hash of these paths in preparation. Descriptor JSON/header text can be static software without treating embedded paths as leaves.

Future output, root once-decision and driver are outside the manifest; driver/root decision use the separately reviewed acyclic CLI-hash scheme.

Neither manifest nor preparation grants execution or validates payload bytes. No future parent/protocol/proof hash enters the semantic policy fingerprint.
